name: ifixai
description: Independent audit for AI agents, run against the one you actually deployed. Sign in and the open-source inspections run free on your own machine with your own key; a paid workspace adds the iFixAi-only inspections, runs we execute for you, saved history and the report. Connect your agent's endpoint, simulate red-teaming and operational-assurance inspections against it, and get an audit back: what it got wrong, with the prompt and its own reply as evidence. Graded by an independent judge model that iFixAi picks, against a fixed passing bar you cannot tune. If your own agent runs the judge model, say so, because that run is not independent.
